paragraphs: AI: "OpenAI models go rogue" (The Hill) leads the coverage. Also notable: "King Charles warns top AI leaders of ‘existential dangers,’ offers proposals to rein in technology" (New York Post).

Political: "Lockheed Martin boasts of faster interceptor missile production turnaround as stockpiles run low" (Washington Examiner) leads the coverage. Also notable: "US passenger duct-taped to plane seat says: ‘I don’t remember any of it’" (The Guardian).

Economic: "Fed Chairman Warsh Escapes Trump’s Ire Over Interest Rate Hike" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "France Seeks to Pare Deficit Next Year After Missing 2026 Target" (Bloomberg).

Financial: "Mortgage rates jump to nearly 7% after Fed rate hike — highest in nearly two years" (New York Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Couple spends SpaceX IPO riches on $25K-a-month year of travel to French Alps, Italian Grand Prix" (New York Post).

Geopolitical: "China asks Iran to rein in Houthis after appeal from Saudi Arabia" (Washington Examiner) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Greens push Zack Polanski to take stance on proposed policy declaring ‘Zionism is racism’" (The Guardian).
